vitals.alert_force_tooltip: Automatic: forces nothing, the real state above follows the game normally. Choosing a specific state forces it in-game and holds it until you switch back to Automatic - code patch (see install_alert_dispatch_hook in native/speedhack.c), experimental: the on-screen timer does not count down naturally while the override stays active, and switching back to Automatic instantly reverts to the real state (no animated transition).
vitals.no_alerts_tooltip: Code patch (not just memory read/write): short-circuits the function that triggers the alert state - enemies still react locally to your presence (individual detection, a separate system), but the global alert state never triggers. Never applied to the player.
vitals.infinite_ammo_tooltip: Freezes the real current reserve of each weapon at the moment you check it (not an artificial fixed value) and rewrites it continuously while checked.
vitals.no_reload_tooltip: Code patch (not a looped rewrite): removes the write of the new magazine count after a shot, whatever weapon is equipped - set up once, no periodic reassertion.
vitals.instant_kill_tooltip:
Experimental - code patch (not just memory read/write like the rest of the trainer, see native/speedhack.c). Never applied to the player. The Lethal/Non-lethal button on the right picks the effect.
Gekkos and tanks: killed in one hit (Lethal mode), including tanks with a weapon that normally does no damage to them (bullets, etc.).
Bosses: no exploitable damage instruction found - each real hit drops health/stamina in 25% steps instead of an instant kill, the final hit remaining a real game hit (avoids softlocking the end of the fight, see notes.md).
vitals.railgun_charge: Rail Gun / Solar Gun Always Charged
vitals.railgun_charge_tooltip: Code patch: the Rail Gun and Solar Gun are fully charged as soon as you pull the trigger (visual effect and Snake's shout included), with no wait and no dependence on solar energy. A fully charged shot's damage also applies to tanks.
vitals.lethal_tooltip: One hit kills any enemy it touches.
vitals.non_lethal_tooltip: Normal damage is no longer applied at all.

help.text:
This trainer reads and WRITES live into the memory of the mgs4.exe process while a game is running (not the save file): forces any already-identified field (weapons, items, stats, health/stamina/stress/Solid Eye battery...) and also serves as a research tool for IDs that are still unknown.

Requires MGS4 (Steam version) to be running with a save loaded — "(Re)connect" tries to attach to the running process.

Calibrated and tested on Steam version 1.4.1 of the GAME (not to be confused with the version above, which is the trainer's). Memory addresses depend on the exact exe version: a game update can shift all of them at once (already happened on 2026-09-24, fixed since). If a future update breaks detection (stuck on "Not connected", or the consistency check keeps failing after reconnecting), see notes.md for the recalibration method.

Single-player use only, at your own risk: this is not an official tool, it reads/writes into another process's memory, which an antivirus may flag incorrectly. Some fields remain low-confidence or not yet individually tested (see notes.md case by case). "Advanced mode" hides by default items whose in-game behavior is uncertain or dangerous (e.g. an item that crashes the game when equipped, confirmed multiple times) — only enable it knowing the risks.
